quotes:
## `public_op:source_folder.read_named_source`

### Owner

`module:source_folder`.

### Callers

`module:photo_delivery`.

### Inputs

The path of the photo folder and the requested name.

### Outputs

Nothing when the name fails condition 1 of A3 rule 5. Otherwise a `SourceRead`: one `SourceFile`, and the bytes that were judged when it is ready.

### Observable effect

Reads one file once.

### Enforces

Condition 1 of A3 rule 5, A1 orders 1 to 6, INV-01, INV-02 and INV-19.
judgement.why: State 5 explicitly assigns enforcement of A1 orders 1 through 6 during delivery to source_folder.read_named_source.
